params.body:
## Why

Editors could take a trend off gentells.com, but not say why. They also could not see which trends on the site nobody had looked at yet. Needs gentells-pipeline #453 (reasons and looks) merged first.

## What changes

- **Trends tab**
  - It opens on **New on the site**: the trends nobody has looked at, newest first, with since when each one is on the site.
  - Each has **Looks right** (it stays, and leaves the list) and **Take off**. Take off opens a short list of reasons, and the choice takes it off.
  - Both say what they did, with Undo.
  - **Online, looked at** says who looked and when. **Taken off** says who, when and why.
- **Front page tray**: one line, "N trends are on gentells.com that nobody has looked at", with a link to Trends.
- `src/trend-desk.js`: the list order, the editor's name (the address before the @) and the reason label, with tests.

## Checked

- `npm test` 70/70, `vite build` green.
- Looked at in a local preview against sample trend data: the queue, the reason choice, the toast with Undo, and the tray line.
params.title: Trend desk: new trends on the site first, taking one off asks why
